resolvedFindings.summary: A stale open form cannot recover through Refresh; its submitted revision remains stale.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: Open Edit brief at revision 1, enter a draft, write revision 2 through CLI, Save =>409, Refresh => UI shows Revision 2, Save =>409 with request revision=1.
resolvedFindings.fix: The author added an explicit draft rebase action preserving inputs; verify against rebuilt assets.
resolvedFindings.verification: Built dashboard headless recheck: 409 at stale revision; explicit draft rebase retains My edit and saves HTTP200 with revision2, producing revision3. Delayed /api/projects also exposes no editable form before project resolution.

resolvedFindings.summary: Refreshing Codex native skills silently overwrites existing unmanaged .agents/skills entries with colliding names.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: Preseed .agents/skills/project/SKILL.md with custom user content, then copy current sw plugin into .agents/skills with no force. Returns success=true; original content is replaced and no backup remains.
resolvedFindings.fix: Use consistently namespaced managed destinations or preserve/back up conflicting user files before replacement, and test the actual refresh path.
resolvedFindings.verification: Independent Vite SSR source execution under Node22: real legacy copy seeded global receipt; new native copy succeeded in two project roots; unnamespaced custom skill preserved; colliding sw-project content backed up byte-for-byte; unchanged native repeat skipped.

resolvedFindings.summary: Codex native skill migration can report success while leaving .agents/skills absent because refresh reuses a global source hash without checking its destination.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: Copy current sw plugin to .codex/skills, then call copyPluginSkillsToProject with targetSkillsDir=.agents/skills and no force. First call copies 12 skills; second returns success=true, skipped=true; .agents/skills does not exist.
resolvedFindings.fix: Require target-specific evidence before skipping; cover legacy-to-native migration and multiple project roots.
resolvedFindings.verification: Independent Vite SSR source execution under Node22: real legacy copy seeded global receipt; new native copy succeeded in two project roots; unnamespaced custom skill preserved; colliding sw-project content backed up byte-for-byte; unchanged native repeat skipped.

resolvedFindings.summary: Companion executable files lose executable permissions during native skill installation.
resolvedFindings.reproduction: Source scripts/check.sh is mode0755; installNativeSkills writes it as0644; direct spawn fails with EACCES.
resolvedFindings.fix: Carry source permissions into installation and verify executable-bit state as well as file bytes.
resolvedFindings.verification: Independent source fixture now installs mode0755, executes successfully, skips unchanged state and detects/repairs mode-only drift with a backup. Native installer/adapter/refresh suites: 3 files, 18 tests passed.
